verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency is a fair axis for a domain registrar, but the evidence pack has no Porkbun at-cost claim, no visible registry or ICANN fee breakdown, and no published low-margin guarantee. The pricing-lookup API (porkbun-docs-35) only exposes prices, not how they relate to wholesale cost. Community comments about Porkbun being cheaper, or about its likely thin margins, are anecdotal and conflict with each other, so they do not show the documented capability the story requires.

support.subject: As a power user, pricing is at or near wholesale — at-cost claims backed by visible registry fee breakdowns or a published low-margin guarantee
